Observation
Squeeze fired 04-21 from mom −1.15 → +3.08; peaked +4.44 (04-24), decayed to +3.23 (73% of peak). Color chopped lime → green → lime 3× during fire — momentum noisy at the top, not impulsively expanding. Squeeze re-formed today (B+1) with mom still positive.

Signal logic: state=ON & mom>0 & color↑ → secondary coil with bullish lean → WAIT. Confidence held to 0.42 because (a) σ z = +0.06 says mom is unremarkable for GDDY's own distribution, (b) coil=1 has no body of evidence yet, (c) secondary compressions have lower base-rate fire→continuation than fresh squeezes.
# kpi schema
state   on / off · B+n (bars in squeeze) / D+n (days since fire)
coil    bars in current squeeze run
mom    latest histogram value (linreg of close vs 20-bar mid)
Δ 1d   1-bar change in mom
σ z 60d mom z-score vs trailing 60d distribution

# decision schema
signal   BUY / WAIT / NEUTRAL / SHORT — derived from state × color × Δ × z
conf    0–1 score (coil-depth + color-stability + z-magnitude)
trigger condition that flips signal to BUY/SHORT
inval   condition that downgrades signal to NEUTRAL/opposite
horizon typical bars-to-resolution for the setup family

# signal rules
BUY    → state OFF (D≤3) & color=lime & Δ>0 & px>EMA8
WAIT   → state ON & color=green/lime (coiling bull)  OR  secondary coil
SHORT → state OFF (D≤3) & color=red & Δ<0 & gates: VIX≥25, RSI≥75
NEUT  → no squeeze, mom flat, |z|<0.5
